digest.component_or_area: LLM eval framework and gold-set validation
propositions: Eval specs and gold-set expectation strings reference Success Criteria vocabulary that has been removed from reviewer prompts, causing spec-to-rubric misalignment
eval_solver.py generates fixture descriptions with duplicate Acceptance Criteria and Success Criteria headings containing identical text
Fixture description generation must emit exactly one Acceptance Criteria heading with no Success Criteria block after vocabulary collapse
Gold-set test expectations must be updated from Success Criteria phrasing to Acceptance Criteria phrasing while maintaining identical pass/fail tally
Permanent vocabulary carve-outs in plan_review_T2.md, plan_review_verifier.md, and verify_models.py must be preserved unchanged
